verdict.rationale: INPI is France's national intellectual-property office. Its core product is legally authoritative filing and registration of trademarks, patents and designs, plus the official registries. A government registry whose legal effect comes from the office itself cannot be run on your own infrastructure, so self-hosting is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any self-hostable software distribution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
